android.desc:
Housie is a popular board game in India; it is also known as Bingo or Tambola in different parts of the world. Housie or Tambola is very easy to play by listening to a caller read out randomly drawn numbers.

M-Housie by Synergy Technology Services Pvt. Ltd. is a live online party game which can play anytime and anywhere with friends or family. This application involves the Caller (Generates housie/tambola tickets and calls out randomly generated numbers) and Players. Caller in the Housie game will generate tickets having unique QR codes, on the device, and Players can get their respective tickets by scanning the barcodes from their own devices, off the Caller’s device.

Guidelines:
Gameplay -
The game starts with a random number draw. As the game progresses, the board (on the Caller’s device) is marked with the number that is drawn. The aim of the game is to mark all the numbers in the ticket (on each of the player’s respective devices) as called by the caller. Any player who first marks all the numbers in a winning pattern, and calls a win, is declared as the WINNER of that pattern, only after verification by the caller.
The game ends when a winner is declared for FULL HOUSIE.

Housie Winning Patterns –
In order to win, the player needs to match the following winning combinations:
• Early Five
• First Row
• Second Row
• Third Row
• Four Corners
• Full Housie

Enjoy the game!!! and we are always there to help. Feedback and suggestions are always appreciated.
